message.content: {"action":"change_rounding","reason":"Current best is coef_frac=15, rne, symmetric_preadd at 85.14 dB SQNR and 8520 um^2. Increasing precision is exhausted, decreasing precision would drop SQNR substantially (to ~78.7 dB at frac=14), and switching architecture is already at the symmetric_preadd optimum. Changing rounding mode explores 5 legal unvisited neighbors and may improve numerical quality without reducing coefficient precision or increasing area."}
